description: This Java source file defines the class PsiResourceItem, which extends ResourceItem, and handles parsing and managing Android resource items, including XML resource parsing, resource value creation, and configuration handling within the Android Studio environment.

classes.name: PsiResourceItem
classes.description: Represents an Android resource item with XML parsing capabilities, configuration management, and resource value generation, used within Android Studio's rendering and resource management system.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the folder configuration for this resource item, with a fallback to derive configuration from the parent folder if source is null.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Retrieves the source ResourceFile, creating a PsiResourceFile if necessary based on the file's parent folder.

methods.name: getResourceValue
methods.description: Returns the ResourceValue for this resource item, parsing XML if needed, and handling density-based resources.

methods.name: getFolderDensity
methods.description: Gets the density qualifier value from the folder configuration, if available.

methods.name: parseXmlToResourceValue
methods.description: Parses the associated XML tag to produce a ResourceValue, handling different resource types like style, attr, array, plurals, and string.

methods.name: getAttributeValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified attribute from an XmlTag.

methods.name: parseDeclareStyleable
methods.description: Parses a declare-styleable XML tag to extract attribute values.

methods.name: parseStyleValue
methods.description: Parses a style XML tag to extract style attributes.

methods.name: parseAttrValue
methods.description: Parses attribute XML tags to extract attribute values.

methods.name: parseArrayValue
methods.description: Parses array XML tags to extract array elements.

methods.name: parsePluralsValue
methods.description: Parses plurals XML tags to extract plural quantities.

methods.name: parseValue
methods.description: Sets the text value of a resource from the XML tag content.

methods.name: getTextContent
methods.description: Extracts the combined text content from an XML tag, handling nested tags and special cases like xliff.

methods.name: parseTextValue
methods.description: Parses a text resource value from the XML tag.

methods.name: getXmlTextValue
methods.description: Extracts text from an XmlText element, handling CDATA sections.

methods.name: appendText
methods.description: Recursively appends text content from an XML tag and its children, supporting xliff tags.

methods.name: getPsiFile
methods.description: Returns the associated PsiFile.

methods.name: recomputeValue
methods.description: Clears cached resource value to force re-computation.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the associated XmlTag.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks reference equality for resource item instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on resource name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation including resource content.
